title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 19 September 2026
description: Today: Europe reacts to Australia skipping West Bank trade sanctions as SunRice job cuts hit a small Riverina town hard; the QAFL Grand Final caps off the season and a woman is charged over an alleged cash for demerit points scheme; and the Gold Coast Suns call in the Titans to fix their tackling ahead of an AFLW trade shake-up. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
